details.notes: Lions share of possession in the first half and a score of goals, what is not to like. But the last 25 minutes will need a serious review to see what went wrong and how to improve. As before the managers interview after the match was the definition of coaching - nothing to be dissappointed with, only opportunities to improve. We are all learning the new playing style and I for one am happy with the results. A win would be nice, but very nice to watch and great to see Derek McInnes sweating in the home dugout. #claret&amber  #COYW!!

Once again - lots of possession but not any precision in the final third. First game since the record transfer fee from Lennon Miller going to Udinese, but we need to fill the void and get a striker or two on the squad. No use having 70% possession, but 0-0 draw after 90 minutes. Through the the quarter-finals and onwards from there hopefully. #claret&amber  #COYW!!

A lot of possession but not any precision. Sad story from an otherwise impressive display from the Well. A few good chances that came to nothing, but not a game to remember. Windy conditions ruined the game, but a share of the points is better than a loss. #claret&amber  #COYW!!

A sloppy goal conceded from self inflicted corner, was not part of the game plan. But since when do Motherwell make it easy on themselves. They held out for the remainder of the first have, with a smattering of opportunities to speak of themselves. But the plan was fully executed for the majority of the second half. Dominant, free flowing and most of all joyous to watch. Rangers were not just on the back foot, they were beaten to every ball, every half chance. Their own manager expressed his lack of confidence in post match interviews, saying they were lucky to get a point. Jens Berthel Askou was genuinely disappointed with the result, half expecting to get all three points. But it was not to be, either way if this is the future - bring in on! #claret&amber  #COYW!!

At last. A game that Motherwell have controlled and looked close to comfortable, for the majority of play.  Many commentators praised the team for commited and progressive play, with the manager saying he'd rather they made mistake for being to adventurous than from sitting back and being safe.  An easy tap in for Stamatelopoulos and a double for Maswanhise - his second goal was an absolute SCREAMER.  If this is the way we can play against one of the first 'proper' teams we've faced, then we should be in good shape for the season ahead. Let's just hope its a taste of things to come under our new manager.  #COYW!!
Third painful game in a row. Weather played a big part in the match, as well as the tattie field they called a pitch. Write it up as a win, but nothing to celebrate on the road back home.  #COYW!!

Another nervy performance from a team clearly finding it's way through the game. The Longelo goal was a screamer and gives me hope for better things to come. But we can only pray this is pre-season jitters and the team will come good in the league.  #COYW!!
Far from convincing, slightly worrying to be fair. To get the bonus point and win penalties is good, but should never have needed to take that long. #COYW!!
